name: SkyGenAI
author: SKYIT Polska

sections.description:
SkyGenAI is a powerful content creation assistant that integrates directly into your WordPress editor. It allows you to generate complete, well-structured blog posts from just a title, using a connected Generative AI API (currently supporting Google Gemini).

Save time, overcome writer’s block, and streamline your content workflow with a single click.

Key Features:

  • One-Click Content Generation: Turn a simple title into a full-fledged article.
  • SEO-Friendly Structure: Generated content includes proper H2/H3 headings, lists, and a helpful FAQ section to improve your on-page SEO.
  • Smart Formatting: The plugin intelligently converts the AI’s response into clean, editable blocks for the Gutenberg editor.
  • Secure API Key Storage: Your API key is stored safely and securely in your WordPress database.
  • Easy Configuration: Simply add your API key on the settings page, and you’re ready to create.

This plugin is an independent tool developed by SKYIT Polska and is not officially affiliated with or endorsed by Google or any other AI service provider.

Usage

  1. Start a new post or edit an existing one.
  2. Write a clear and descriptive title for your article.
  3. Look for the “SkyGenAI Content Generator” box in the editor sidebar.
  4. Click the “Generate Content” button.
  5. Watch as the AI-generated content is seamlessly inserted into your editor.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the skygenai folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Settings -> SkyGenAI.
  4. Enter your API key (e.g., your Google Gemini key from Google AI Studio).
  5. Click “Save Changes”.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

The SkyGenAI plugin is free and open-source. However, it requires an API key from a third-party AI provider (like Google Gemini). Use of that API may be subject to costs based on the provider’s pricing model.

Where can I get an API key?

Currently, the plugin is configured for the Google Gemini API. You can get a key from Google AI Studio.

Is the generated content original?

The content is created by the AI model in real-time and is generally unique. It is always recommended to review, edit, and add your own voice to the content to ensure it aligns perfectly with your brand and quality standards.
